messages:
marta: quick flag — saw a bunch of traces that get a new root when a delayed job is processed, breaks parent-child mapping
ken: how delayed are we talking?
marta: hours. SQS delayed retry + manual replay. the worker shows a new root span instead of continuing the original trace_id
sophie: is the trace id getting dropped or are we generating a new one on receive?
marta: looks like our gateway currently attaches a full OTLP attr blob as a message attribute. downstream DLQ/replay pipelines are normalizing attrs and sometimes drop it. result: worker restarts instrumentation and creates new root
rajesh: we should avoid shipping the full span payload. propose a compact signed "attestation" token that carries minimal fields: trace_id, parent_span_id, sampled_flag, orig_ts, ttl, version, kid, replay_counter
ken: +1. small and signed so worker can trust it and rehydrate parent link without needing full OTLP attrs
sophie: nits: SQS and some broker limits mean message attributes or headers have size caps. aim for <1kb. use base64-compact json, rotate signing keys via KMS, and include a version field for future changes
ken: example header suggestion:
```
Trace-Attest: eyJ2IjoiMSIsInQiOiI0ZmYx... (base64)
# decodes to: {"v":"1","t":"4ff1...","p":"a1b2...","s":1,"ts":168900...,"ttl":86400,"k":"kid-2026-03","r":0,"sig":"..."}
```
marta: also need to handle sampling semantics: if sampled_flag=0 worker should still create a minimal "link" span to preserve topology but avoid exporting heavy payloads unless local sampling flips on
rajesh: exporters must be tolerant: if they see reused trace_id with later spans, they should dedupe but accept link joins. we should add a replay_counter to attest token so exporter can detect replays and optionally annotate
oliver: what about tampering? signed token with KMS HMAC or asymmetric sign. HMAC keeps token small, asymmetric gives verifiability across accounts. probably HMAC + kid pointing to KMS key id is fine for internal queues
sophie: we also need TTL enforcement. worker should reject attestation if now > ts + ttl and then fall back to new root, but still attach the expired attestation as a link with reason=expired
marta: edge case: what if multiple replayers in different regions change parent_span_id order? include an ordered replay_counter so we can reconstruct last known parent id
ken: and versioning: v1 minimal, v2 may include sampling-rationale or sample-score for probabilistic sampling
rajesh: exporters: update agent to add "attestation_metadata" field on spans so downstream storage can index replay_counter and attestation_kid for retention queries
rajesh: retention question: if replayed traces bump retention (user sees multiple traces for same event), we should annotate and potentially collapse in console UX. Redwood Console can show "replayed" badge
devops-bot: deploy queued: telemetry/attest-middleware v0.1 -> staging :rocket:
sophie: I'll prototype the middleware that signs/verifies tokens and puts them into message attributes. I'll keep format lib-agnostic and add tests for size and expired TTL
marta: I'll add unit tests for replay cases and a regression test that replays a job after 8 hours and asserts parent-child relation preserved
oliver: can someone write a short explainer for infra runbook? we need operational guidance for key rotation and what to do on key compromise
marta: yep, will draft. followups: define final token schema, choose HMAC vs RSA, size budget, and a small set of test replays. assigning: sophie -> middleware, ken -> worker integration, rajesh -> exporter tolerance changes, oliver -> runbook + console UX note
ken: :thumbsup:
sophie: cool, will PR in next 48h
rajesh: thumbs, will update exporter API soon
